verses.ar: قَدۡ اَفۡلَحَ الۡمُؤۡمِنُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: The believers must (eventually) win through

verses.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ فِيۡ صَلَاتِهِمۡ خٰشِعُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Those who humble themselves in their prayers

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ عَنِ اللَّغۡوِ مُعۡرِضُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Who avoid vain talk

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ لِلزَّكٰوةِ فٰعِلُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Who are active in deeds of charity

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ لِفُرُوۡجِهِمۡ حٰفِظُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Who abstain from sex

verses.ar: اِلَّا عَلٰ٘ي اَزۡوَاجِهِمۡ اَوۡ مَا مَلَكَتۡ اَيۡمَانُهُمۡ فَاِنَّهُمۡ غَيۡرُ مَلُوۡمِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Except with those joined to them in the marriage bond, or (the captives) whom their right hands possess,- for (in their case) they are free from blame

verses.ar: فَمَنِ ابۡتَغٰي وَرَآءَ ذٰلِكَ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡعٰدُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: But those whose desires exceed those limits are transgressors

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ لِاَمٰنٰتِهِمۡ وَعَهۡدِهِمۡ رٰعُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Those who faithfully observe their trusts and their covenants

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ عَلٰي صَلَوٰتِهِمۡ يُحَافِظُوۡنَۘ‏
verses.en: And who (strictly) guard their prayers

verses.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡوٰرِثُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: These will be the heirs

verses.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ يَرِثُوۡنَ الۡفِرۡدَوۡسَؕ هُمۡ فِيۡهَا خٰلِدُوۡنَ
verses.en: Who will inherit Paradise: they will dwell therein (for ever)

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ مِنۡ سُلٰلَةٍ مِّنۡ طِيۡنٍۚ‏
verses.en: Man We did create from a quintessence (of clay)

verses.ar: ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنٰهُ نُطۡفَةً فِيۡ قَرَارٍ مَّكِيۡنٍࣕ‏
verses.en: Then We placed him as (a drop of) sperm in a place of rest, firmly fixed

verses.ar: ثُمَّ خَلَقۡنَا النُّطۡفَةَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقۡنَا الۡعَلَقَةَ مُضۡغَةً فَخَلَقۡنَا الۡمُضۡغَةَ عِظٰمًا فَكَسَوۡنَا الۡعِظٰمَ لَحۡمًاࣗ ثُمَّ اَنۡشَاۡنٰهُ خَلۡقًا اٰخَرَؕ فَتَبٰرَكَ اللّٰهُ اَحۡسَنُ الۡخٰلِقِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Then We made the sperm into a clot of congealed blood; then of that clot We made a (foetus) lump; then we made out of that lump bones and clothed the bones with flesh; then we developed out of it another creature. So blessed be Allah, the best to create

verses.ar: ثُمَّ اِنَّكُمۡ بَعۡدَ ذٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: After that, at length ye will die

verses.ar: ثُمَّ اِنَّكُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ تُبۡعَثُوۡنَ
verses.en: Again, on the Day of Judgment, will ye be raised up

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمۡ سَبۡعَ طَرَآئِقَࣗۖ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ الۡخَلۡقِ غٰفِلِيۡنَ
verses.en: And We have made, above you, seven tracts; and We are never unmindful of (our) Creation

verses.ar: وَاَنۡزَلۡنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ بِقَدَرٍ فَاَسۡكَنّٰهُ فِي الۡاَرۡضِࣗۖ وَاِنَّا عَلٰي ذَهَابٍۭ بِهٖ لَقٰدِرُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: And We send down water from the sky according to (due) measure, and We cause it to soak in the soil; and We certainly are able to drain it off (with ease)

verses.ar: فَاَنۡشَاۡنَا لَكُمۡ بِهٖ جَنّٰتٍ مِّنۡ نَّخِيۡلٍ وَّاَعۡنَابٍۘ لَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا فَوَاكِهُ كَثِيۡرَةٌ وَّمِنۡهَا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: With it We grow for you gardens of date-palms and vines: in them have ye abundant fruits: and of them ye eat (and have enjoyment)

verses.ar: وَشَجَرَةً تَخۡرُجُ مِنۡ طُوۡرِ سَيۡنَآءَ تَنۭۡ بُتُ بِالدُّهۡنِ وَصِبۡغٍ لِّلۡاٰكِلِيۡنَ
verses.en: Also a tree springing out of Mount Sinai, which produces oil, and relish for those who use it for food

verses.ar: وَاِنَّ لَكُمۡ فِي الۡاَنۡعَامِ لَعِبۡرَةًؕ نُسۡقِيۡكُمۡ مِّمَّا فِيۡ بُطُوۡنِهَا وَلَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا مَنَافِعُ كَثِيۡرَةٌ وَّمِنۡهَا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: And in cattle (too) ye have an instructive example: from within their bodies We produce (milk) for you to drink; there are, in them, (besides), numerous (other) benefits for you; and of their (meat) ye eat

verses.ar: وَعَلَيۡهَا وَعَلَي الۡفُلۡكِ تُحۡمَلُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: And on them, as well as in ships, ye ride

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوۡحًا اِلٰي قَوۡمِهٖ فَقَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اِلٰهٍ غَيۡرُهٗؕ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَ
verses.en: (Further, We sent a long line of prophets for your instruction). We sent Noah to his people: He said, "O my people! worship Allah! Ye have no other god but Him. Will ye not fear (Him)

verses.ar: فَقَالَ الۡمَلَؤُا الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا مِنۡ قَوۡمِهٖ مَا هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُكُمۡۙ يُرِيۡدُ اَنۡ يَّتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡؕ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ لَاَنۡزَلَ مَلٰٓئِكَةًۚۖ مَّا سَمِعۡنَا بِهٰذَا فِيۡ٘ اٰبَآئِنَا الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَۚۖ‏
verses.en: The chiefs of the Unbelievers among his people said: "He is no more than a man like yourselves: his wish is to assert his superiority over you: if Allah had wished (to send messengers), He could have sent down angels; never did we hear such a thing (as he says), among our ancestors of old

verses.ar: اِنۡ هُوَ اِلَّا رَجُلٌۭ بِهٖ جِنَّةٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوۡا بِهٖ حَتّٰي حِيۡنٍ
verses.en: (And some said): "He is only a man possessed: wait (and have patience) with him for a time

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ انۡصُرۡنِيۡ بِمَا كَذَّبُوۡنِ
verses.en: (Noah) said: "O my Lord! help me: for that they accuse me of falsehood

verses.ar: فَاَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡهِ اَنِ اصۡنَعِ الۡفُلۡكَ بِاَعۡيُنِنَا وَوَحۡيِنَا فَاِذَا جَآءَ اَمۡرُنَا وَفَارَ التَّنُّوۡرُۙ فَاسۡلُكۡ فِيۡهَا مِنۡ كُلٍّ زَوۡجَيۡنِ اثۡنَيۡنِ وَاَهۡلَكَ اِلَّا مَنۡ سَبَقَ عَلَيۡهِ الۡقَوۡلُ مِنۡهُمۡۚ وَلَا تُخَاطِبۡنِيۡ فِي الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡاۚ اِنَّهُمۡ مُّغۡرَقُوۡنَ
verses.en: So We inspired him (with this message): "Construct the Ark within Our sight and under Our guidance: then when comes Our Command, and the fountains of the earth gush forth, take thou on board pairs of every species, male and female, and thy family- except those of them against whom the Word has already gone forth: And address Me not in favour of the wrong-doers; for they shall be drowned (in the Flood)

verses.ar: فَاِذَا اسۡتَوَيۡتَ اَنۡتَ وَمَنۡ مَّعَكَ عَلَي الۡفُلۡكِ فَقُلِ الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيۡ نَجّٰىنَا مِنَ الۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: And when thou hast embarked on the Ark - thou and those with thee,- say: "Praise be to Allah, Who has saved us from the people who do wrong

verses.ar: وَقُلۡ رَّبِّ اَنۡزِلۡنِيۡ مُنۡزَلًا مُّبٰرَكًا وَّاَنۡتَ خَيۡرُ الۡمُنۡزِلِيۡنَ
verses.en: And say: "O my Lord! enable me to disembark with thy blessing: for Thou art the Best to enable (us) to disembark

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ وَّاِنۡ كُنَّا لَمُبۡتَلِيۡنَ
verses.en: Verily in this there are Signs (for men to understand); (thus) do We try (men)

verses.ar: ثُمَّ اَنۡشَاۡنَا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهِمۡ قَرۡنًا اٰخَرِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Then We raised after them another generation

verses.ar: فَاَرۡسَلۡنَا فِيۡهِمۡ رَسُوۡلًا مِّنۡهُمۡ اَنِ اعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اِلٰهٍ غَيۡرُهٗؕ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: And We sent to them a messenger from among themselves, (saying), "Worship Allah! ye have no other god but Him. Will ye not fear (Him)

verses.ar: وَقَالَ الۡمَلَاُ مِنۡ قَوۡمِهِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا وَكَذَّبُوۡا بِلِقَآءِ الۡاٰخِرَةِ وَاَتۡرَفۡنٰهُمۡ فِي الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَاۙ مَا هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُكُمۡۙ يَاۡكُلُ مِمَّا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَ مِنۡهُ وَيَشۡرَبُ مِمَّا تَشۡرَبُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: And the chiefs of his people, who disbelieved and denied the Meeting in the Hereafter, and on whom We had bestowed the good things of this life, said: "He is no more than a man like yourselves: he eats of that of which ye eat, and drinks of what ye drink

verses.ar: وَلَئِنۡ اَطَعۡتُمۡ بَشَرًا مِّثۡلَكُمۡۙ اِنَّكُمۡ اِذًا لَّخٰسِرُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: If ye obey a man like yourselves, behold, it is certain ye will be lost

verses.ar: اَيَعِدُكُمۡ اَنَّكُمۡ اِذَا مِتُّمۡ وَكُنۡتُمۡ تُرَابًا وَّعِظَامًا اَنَّكُمۡ مُّخۡرَجُوۡنَࣕۙ‏
verses.en: Does he promise that when ye die and become dust and bones, ye shall be brought forth (again)

verses.ar: هَيۡهَاتَ هَيۡهَاتَ لِمَا تُوۡعَدُوۡنَࣕۙ‏
verses.en: Far, very far is that which ye are promised

verses.ar: اِنۡ هِيَ اِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنۡيَا نَمُوۡتُ وَنَحۡيَا وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَبۡعُوۡثِيۡنَࣕۙ‏
verses.en: There is nothing but our life in this world! We shall die and we live! But we shall never be raised up again

verses.ar: اِنۡ هُوَ اِلَّا رَجُلُ اِۨفۡتَرٰي عَلَي اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا وَّمَا نَحۡنُ لَهٗ بِمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: He is only a man who invents a lie against Allah, but we are not the ones to believe in him

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ انۡصُرۡنِيۡ بِمَا كَذَّبُوۡنِ
verses.en: (The prophet) said: "O my Lord! help me: for that they accuse me of falsehood

verses.ar: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيۡلٍ لَّيُصۡبِحُنَّ نٰدِمِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: (Allah) said: "In but a little while, they are sure to be sorry

verses.ar: فَاَخَذَتۡهُمُ الصَّيۡحَةُ بِالۡحَقِّ فَجَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ غُثَآءًۚ فَبُعۡدًا لِّلۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: Then the Blast overtook them with justice, and We made them as rubbish of dead leaves (floating on the stream of Time)! So away with the people who do wrong

verses.ar: ثُمَّ اَنۡشَاۡنَا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهِمۡ قُرُوۡنًا اٰخَرِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Then We raised after them other generations

verses.ar: مَا تَسۡبِقُ مِنۡ اُمَّةٍ اَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسۡتَاۡخِرُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: No people can hasten their term, nor can they delay (it)

verses.ar: ثُمَّ اَرۡسَلۡنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتۡرَاؕ كُلَّمَا جَآءَ اُمَّةً رَّسُوۡلُهَا كَذَّبُوۡهُ فَاَتۡبَعۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ بَعۡضًا وَّجَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ اَحَادِيۡثَۚ فَبُعۡدًا لِّقَوۡمٍ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
verses.en: Then sent We our messengers in succession: every time there came to a people their messenger, they accused him of falsehood: so We made them follow each other (in punishment): We made them as a tale (that is told): So away with a people that will not believe

verses.ar: ثُمَّ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوۡسٰي وَاَخَاهُ هٰرُوۡنَ ࣢ۙ بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍۙ‏
verses.en: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron, with Our Signs and authority manifest

verses.ar: اِلٰي فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَا۠ئِهٖ فَاسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا وَكَانُوۡا قَوۡمًا عَالِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: To Pharaoh and his Chiefs: But these behaved insolently: they were an arrogant people

verses.ar: فَقَالُوۡ٘ا اَنُؤۡمِنُ لِبَشَرَيۡنِ مِثۡلِنَا وَقَوۡمُهُمَا لَنَا عٰبِدُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: They said: "Shall we believe in two men like ourselves? And their people are subject to us

verses.ar: فَكَذَّبُوۡهُمَا فَكَانُوۡا مِنَ الۡمُهۡلَكِيۡنَ
verses.en: So they accused them of falsehood, and they became of those who were destroyed

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسَي الۡكِتٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَهۡتَدُوۡنَ
verses.en: And We gave Moses the Book, in order that they might receive guidance

verses.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا ابۡنَ مَرۡيَمَ وَاُمَّهٗ٘ اٰيَةً وَّاٰوَيۡنٰهُمَا٘ اِلٰي رَبۡوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَّمَعِيۡنٍࣖ‏
verses.en: And We made the son of Mary and his mother as a Sign: We gave them both shelter on high ground, affording rest and security and furnished with springs

verses.ar: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الرُّسُلُ كُلُوۡا مِنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِ وَاعۡمَلُوۡا صَالِحًاؕ اِنِّيۡ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ عَلِيۡمٌؕ‏
verses.en: O ye messengers! enjoy (all) things good and pure, and work righteousness: for I am well-acquainted with (all) that ye do

verses.ar: وَاِنَّ هٰذِهٖ٘ اُمَّتُكُمۡ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً وَّاَنَا رَبُّكُمۡ فَاتَّقُوۡنِ
verses.en: And verily this Brotherhood of yours is a single Brotherhood, and I am your Lord and Cherisher: therefore fear Me (and no other)

verses.ar: فَتَقَطَّعُوۡ٘ا اَمۡرَهُمۡ بَيۡنَهُمۡ زُبُرًاؕ كُلُّ حِزۡبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ فَرِحُوۡنَ
verses.en: But people have cut off their affair (of unity), between them, into sects: each party rejoices in that which is with itself

verses.ar: فَذَرۡهُمۡ فِيۡ غَمۡرَتِهِمۡ حَتّٰي حِيۡنٍ
verses.en: But leave them in their confused ignorance for a time

verses.ar: اَيَحۡسَبُوۡنَ اَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُمۡ بِهٖ مِنۡ مَّالٍ وَّبَنِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Do they think that because We have granted them abundance of wealth and sons

verses.ar: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمۡ فِي الۡخَيۡرٰتِؕ بَلۡ لَّا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: We would hasten them on in every good? Nay, they do not understand

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ مِّنۡ خَشۡيَةِ رَبِّهِمۡ مُّشۡفِقُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Verily those who live in awe for fear of their Lord

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Those who believe in the Signs of their Lord

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ بِرَبِّهِمۡ لَا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Those who join not (in worship) partners with their Lord

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ يُؤۡتُوۡنَ مَا٘ اٰتَوۡا وَّقُلُوۡبُهُمۡ وَجِلَةٌ اَنَّهُمۡ اِلٰي رَبِّهِمۡ رٰجِعُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: And those who dispense their charity with their hearts full of fear, because they will return to their Lord

verses.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ يُسٰرِعُوۡنَ فِي الۡخَيۡرٰتِ وَهُمۡ لَهَا سٰبِقُوۡنَ
verses.en: It is these who hasten in every good work, and these who are foremost in them

verses.ar: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفۡسًا اِلَّا وُسۡعَهَا وَلَدَيۡنَا كِتٰبٌ يَّنۡطِقُ بِالۡحَقِّ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: On no soul do We place a burden greater than it can bear: before Us is a record which clearly shows the truth: they will never be wronged

verses.ar: بَلۡ قُلُوۡبُهُمۡ فِيۡ غَمۡرَةٍ مِّنۡ هٰذَا وَلَهُمۡ اَعۡمَالٌ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ ذٰلِكَ هُمۡ لَهَا عٰمِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: But their hearts are in confused ignorance of this; and there are, besides that, deeds of theirs, which they will (continue) to do

verses.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا٘ اَخَذۡنَا مُتۡرَفِيۡهِمۡ بِالۡعَذَابِ اِذَا هُمۡ يَجۡـَٔرُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Until, when We seize in Punishment those of them who received the good things of this world, behold, they will groan in supplication

verses.ar: لَا تَجۡـَٔرُوا الۡيَوۡمَࣞ اِنَّكُمۡ مِّنَّا لَا تُنۡصَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: (It will be said): "Groan not in supplication this day: for ye shall certainly not be helped by Us

verses.ar: قَدۡ كَانَتۡ اٰيٰتِيۡ تُتۡلٰي عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَكُنۡتُمۡ عَلٰ٘ي اَعۡقَابِكُمۡ تَنۡكِصُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: My Signs used to be rehearsed to you, but ye used to turn back on your heels

verses.ar: مُسۡتَكۡبِرِيۡنَࣗۚۖ بِهٖ سٰمِرًا تَهۡجُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: In arrogance: talking nonsense about the (Qur'an), like one telling fables by night

verses.ar: اَفَلَمۡ يَدَّبَّرُوا الۡقَوۡلَ اَمۡ جَآءَهُمۡ مَّا لَمۡ يَاۡتِ اٰبَآءَهُمُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَؗ‏
verses.en: Do they not ponder over the Word (of Allah), or has anything (new) come to them that did not come to their fathers of old

verses.ar: اَمۡ لَمۡ يَعۡرِفُوۡا رَسُوۡلَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَهٗ مُنۡكِرُوۡنَؗ‏
verses.en: Or do they not recognise their Messenger, that they deny him

verses.ar: اَمۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ بِهٖ جِنَّةٌؕ بَلۡ جَآءَهُمۡ بِالۡحَقِّ وَاَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لِلۡحَقِّ كٰرِهُوۡنَ
verses.en: Or do they say, "He is possessed"? Nay, he has brought them the Truth, but most of them hate the Truth

verses.ar: وَلَوِ اتَّبَعَ الۡحَقُّ اَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ لَفَسَدَتِ السَّمٰوٰتُ وَالۡاَرۡضُ وَمَنۡ فِيۡهِنَّؕ بَلۡ اَتَيۡنٰهُمۡ بِذِكۡرِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ عَنۡ ذِكۡرِهِمۡ مُّعۡرِضُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: If the Truth had been in accord with their desires, truly the heavens and the earth, and all beings therein would have been in confusion and corruption! Nay, We have sent them their admonition, but they turn away from their admonition

verses.ar: اَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ خَرۡجًا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرٌࣗۖ وَّهُوَ خَيۡرُ الرّٰزِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: Or is it that thou askest them for some recompense? But the recompense of thy Lord is best: He is the Best of those who give sustenance

verses.ar: وَاِنَّكَ لَتَدۡعُوۡهُمۡ اِلٰي صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍ
verses.en: But verily thou callest them to the Straight Way

verses.ar: وَاِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ عَنِ الصِّرَاطِ لَنٰكِبُوۡنَ
verses.en: And verily those who believe not in the Hereafter are deviating from that Way

verses.ar: وَلَوۡ رَحِمۡنٰهُمۡ وَكَشَفۡنَا مَا بِهِمۡ مِّنۡ ضُرٍّ لَّلَجُّوۡا فِيۡ طُغۡيَانِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُوۡنَ
verses.en: If We had mercy on them and removed the distress which is on them, they would obstinately persist in their transgression, wandering in distraction to and fro

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَخَذۡنٰهُمۡ بِالۡعَذَابِ فَمَا اسۡتَكَانُوۡا لِرَبِّهِمۡ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُوۡنَ
verses.en: We inflicted Punishment on them, but they humbled not themselves to their Lord, nor do they submissively entreat (Him)

verses.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا فَتَحۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ بَابًا ذَا عَذَابٍ شَدِيۡدٍ اِذَا هُمۡ فِيۡهِ مُبۡلِسُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: Until We open on them a gate leading to a severe Punishment: then Lo! they will be plunged in despair therein

verses.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ٘ اَنۡشَاَ لَكُمُ السَّمۡعَ وَالۡاَبۡصَارَ وَالۡاَفۡـِٕدَةَؕ قَلِيۡلًا مَّا تَشۡكُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: It is He Who has created for you (the faculties of) hearing, sight, feeling and understanding: little thanks it is ye give

verses.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ ذَرَاَكُمۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُحۡشَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: And He has multiplied you through the earth, and to Him shall ye be gathered back

verses.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ يُحۡيٖ وَيُمِيۡتُ وَلَهُ اخۡتِلَافُ الَّيۡلِ وَالنَّهَارِؕ اَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: It is He Who gives life and death, and to Him (is due) the alternation of Night and Day: will ye not then understand

verses.ar: بَلۡ قَالُوۡا مِثۡلَ مَا قَالَ الۡاَوَّلُوۡنَ
verses.en: On the contrary they say things similar to what the ancients said

verses.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا ءَاِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَّعِظَامًا ءَاِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوۡثُوۡنَ
verses.en: They say: "What! when we die and become dust and bones, could we really be raised up again

verses.ar: لَقَدۡ وُعِدۡنَا نَحۡنُ وَاٰبَآؤُنَا هٰذَا مِنۡ قَبۡلُ اِنۡ هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا٘ اَسَاطِيۡرُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ
verses.en: Such things have been promised to us and to our fathers before! they are nothing but tales of the ancients

verses.ar: قُلۡ لِّمَنِ الۡاَرۡضُ وَمَنۡ فِيۡهَا٘ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: Say: "To whom belong the earth and all beings therein? (say) if ye know

verses.ar: سَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ لِلّٰهِؕ قُلۡ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوۡنَ
verses.en: They will say, "To Allah!" say: "Yet will ye not receive admonition

verses.ar: قُلۡ مَنۡ رَّبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ السَّبۡعِ وَرَبُّ الۡعَرۡشِ الۡعَظِيۡمِ
verses.en: Say: "Who is the Lord of the seven heavens, and the Lord of the Throne (of Glory) Supreme

verses.ar: سَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ لِلّٰهِؕ قُلۡ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَ
verses.en: They will say, "(They belong) to Allah." Say: "Will ye not then be filled with awe

verses.ar: قُلۡ مَنۭۡ بِيَدِهٖ مَلَكُوۡتُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ وَّهُوَ يُجِيۡرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيۡهِ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: Say: "Who is it in whose hands is the governance of all things,- who protects (all), but is not protected (of any)? (say) if ye know

verses.ar: سَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ لِلّٰهِؕ قُلۡ فَاَنّٰي تُسۡحَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: They will say, "(It belongs) to Allah." Say: "Then how are ye deluded

verses.ar: بَلۡ اَتَيۡنٰهُمۡ بِالۡحَقِّ وَاِنَّهُمۡ لَكٰذِبُوۡنَ
verses.en: We have sent them the Truth: but they indeed practise falsehood

verses.ar: مَا اتَّخَذَ اللّٰهُ مِنۡ وَّلَدٍ وَّمَا كَانَ مَعَهٗ مِنۡ اِلٰهٍ اِذًا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ اِلٰهٍۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلٰي بَعۡضٍؕ سُبۡحٰنَ اللّٰهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: No son did Allah beget, nor is there any god along with Him: (if there were many gods), behold, each god would have taken away what he had created, and some would have lorded it over others! Glory to Allah! (He is free) from the (sort of) things they attribute to Him

verses.ar: عٰلِمِ الۡغَيۡبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَتَعٰلٰي عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: He knows what is hidden and what is open: too high is He for the partners they attribute to Him

verses.ar: قُلۡ رَّبِّ اِمَّا تُرِيَنِّيۡ مَا يُوۡعَدُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Say: "O my Lord! if Thou wilt show me (in my lifetime) that which they are warned against

verses.ar: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجۡعَلۡنِيۡ فِي الۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: Then, O my Lord! put me not amongst the people who do wrong

verses.ar: وَاِنَّا عَلٰ٘ي اَنۡ نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمۡ لَقٰدِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: And We are certainly able to show thee (in fulfilment) that against which they are warned

verses.ar: اِدۡفَعۡ بِالَّتِيۡ هِيَ اَحۡسَنُ السَّيِّئَةَؕ نَحۡنُ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُوۡنَ
verses.en: Repel evil with that which is best: We are well acquainted with the things they say

verses.ar: وَقُلۡ رَّبِّ اَعُوۡذُ بِكَ مِنۡ هَمَزٰتِ الشَّيٰطِيۡنِۙ‏
verses.en: And say "O my Lord! I seek refuge with Thee from the suggestions of the Evil Ones

verses.ar: وَاَعُوۡذُ بِكَ رَبِّ اَنۡ يَّحۡضُرُوۡنِ
verses.en: And I seek refuge with Thee O my Lord! lest they should come near me

verses.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا جَآءَ اَحَدَهُمُ الۡمَوۡتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ارۡجِعُوۡنِۙ‏
verses.en: (In Falsehood will they be) Until, when death comes to one of them, he says: "O my Lord! send me back (to life)

verses.ar: لَعَلِّيۡ٘ اَعۡمَلُ صَالِحًا فِيۡمَا تَرَكۡتُ كَلَّاؕ اِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَاؕ وَمِنۡ وَّرَآئِهِمۡ بَرۡزَخٌ اِلٰي يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُوۡنَ
verses.en: In order that I may work righteousness in the things I neglected." - "By no means! It is but a word he says."- Before them is a Partition till the Day they are raised up

verses.ar: فَاِذَا نُفِخَ فِي الصُّوۡرِ فَلَا٘ اَنۡسَابَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٍ وَّلَا يَتَسَآءَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: Then when the Trumpet is blown, there will be no more relationships between them that Day, nor will one ask after another

verses.ar: فَمَنۡ ثَقُلَتۡ مَوَازِيۡنُهٗ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡمُفۡلِحُوۡنَ
verses.en: Then those whose balance (of good deeds) is heavy,- they will attain salvation

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ خَفَّتۡ مَوَازِيۡنُهٗ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ خَسِرُوۡ٘ا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ فِيۡ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: But those whose balance is light, will be those who have lost their souls, in Hell will they abide

verses.ar: تَلۡفَحُ وُجُوۡهَهُمُ النَّارُ وَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا كٰلِحُوۡنَ
verses.en: The Fire will burn their faces, and they will therein grin, with their lips displaced

verses.ar: اَلَمۡ تَكُنۡ اٰيٰتِيۡ تُتۡلٰي عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَكُنۡتُمۡ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُوۡنَ
verses.en: Were not My Signs rehearsed to you, and ye did but treat them as falsehood

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتۡ عَلَيۡنَا شِقۡوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوۡمًا ضَآلِّيۡنَ
verses.en: They will say: "our Lord! Our misfortune overwhelmed us, and we became a people astray

verses.ar: رَبَّنَا٘ اَخۡرِجۡنَا مِنۡهَا فَاِنۡ عُدۡنَا فَاِنَّا ظٰلِمُوۡنَ
verses.en: Our Lord! bring us out of this: if ever we return (to Evil), then shall we be wrong-doers indeed

verses.ar: قَالَ اخۡسَـُٔوۡا فِيۡهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُوۡنِ
verses.en: He will say: "Be ye driven into it (with ignominy)! And speak ye not to Me

verses.ar: اِنَّهٗ كَانَ فَرِيۡقٌ مِّنۡ عِبَادِيۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ رَبَّنَا٘ اٰمَنَّا فَاغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَارۡحَمۡنَا وَاَنۡتَ خَيۡرُ الرّٰحِمِيۡنَۚۖ‏
verses.en: A part of My servants there was, who used to pray 'our Lord! we believe; then do Thou forgive us, and have mercy upon us: For Thou art the Best of those who show mercy

verses.ar: فَاتَّخَذۡتُمُوۡهُمۡ سِخۡرِيًّا حَتّٰ٘ي اَنۡسَوۡكُمۡ ذِكۡرِيۡ وَكُنۡتُمۡ مِّنۡهُمۡ تَضۡحَكُوۡنَ
verses.en: But ye treated them with ridicule, so much so that (ridicule of) them made you forget My Message while ye were laughing at them

verses.ar: اِنِّيۡ جَزَيۡتُهُمُ الۡيَوۡمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوۡ٘اۙ اَنَّهُمۡ هُمُ الۡفَآئِزُوۡنَ
verses.en: I have rewarded them this Day for their patience and constancy: they are indeed the ones that have achieved Bliss

verses.ar: قٰلَ كَمۡ لَبِثۡتُمۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ عَدَدَ سِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: He will say: "What number of years did ye stay on earth

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا لَبِثۡنَا يَوۡمًا اَوۡ بَعۡضَ يَوۡمٍ فَسۡـَٔلِ الۡعَآدِّيۡنَ
verses.en: They will say: "We stayed a day or part of a day: but ask those who keep account

verses.ar: قٰلَ اِنۡ لَّبِثۡتُمۡ اِلَّا قَلِيۡلًا لَّوۡ اَنَّكُمۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: He will say: "Ye stayed not but a little,- if ye had only known

verses.ar: اَفَحَسِبۡتُمۡ اَنَّمَا خَلَقۡنٰكُمۡ عَبَثًا وَّاَنَّكُمۡ اِلَيۡنَا لَا تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
verses.en: Did ye then think that We had created you in jest, and that ye would not be brought back to Us (for account)

verses.ar: فَتَعٰلَي اللّٰهُ الۡمَلِكُ الۡحَقُّۚ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَۚ رَبُّ الۡعَرۡشِ الۡكَرِيۡمِ
verses.en: Therefore exalted be Allah, the King, the Reality: there is no god but He, the Lord of the Throne of Honour

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ يَّدۡعُ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَۙ لَا بُرۡهَانَ لَهٗ بِهٖۙ فَاِنَّمَا حِسَابُهٗ عِنۡدَ رَبِّهٖؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا يُفۡلِحُ الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: If anyone invokes, besides Allah, Any other god, he has no authority therefor; and his reckoning will be only with his Lord! and verily the Unbelievers will fail to win through

verses.ar: وَقُلۡ رَّبِّ اغۡفِرۡ وَارۡحَمۡ وَاَنۡتَ خَيۡرُ الرّٰحِمِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: So say: "O my Lord! grant Thou forgiveness and mercy for Thou art the Best of those who show mercy
